data.one_liner: A flexible Flutter package for creating staggered grid layouts with variable-sized items.
data.what_it_does: The staggered_grid_view package allows developers to build staggered grid layouts where items can span multiple rows and columns. It provides various constructors for fixed, extent-based, and dynamically built grids with lazy loading capabilities.
use_when: You need to display items of varying sizes in a grid layout similar to Pinterest.
You want a familiar GridView-like API with custom staggered tile sizing.
avoid_when: You only require standard uniform grid cells where every item has the exact same dimensions.
strengths: Supports both fixed and dynamic extents for items.
Offers lazy loading and automatic keep-alives for performance.
Familiar API mirroring Flutter's built-in GridView.
weaknesses: Limited documentation or features beyond the open beta release.
Not mentioned if advanced custom layout delegates can be written from scratch easily outside the provided Sliver delegates.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is an established package in the catalog providing similar staggered grid view capabilities.

data.minimal_example:
StaggeredGridView.count(
  crossAxisCount: 4,
  staggeredTiles: const [
    StaggeredTile.count(2, 2),
    StaggeredTile.count(1, 2),
  ],
  children: List.generate(2, (index) => Card(child: Text('Item $index'))),
)
